definition: SUM(order_items.quantity * order_items.unit_price * (1 - order_items.discount)), counting only orders with status 'delivered' or 'shipped' (cancelled and returned orders are excluded).
revenue minus SUM(order_items.quantity * products.cost), over the same delivered/shipped orders.
SUM(order_items.quantity) over orders with status 'delivered' or 'shipped'.
revenue divided by the number of distinct delivered/shipped orders. Also called AOV.
a customer with at least one order whose status is 'delivered' or 'shipped'.
an employee whose manager_id is not NULL. Employees with NULL manager_id are regional managers.
employees.region; an order's region is the region of the employee who handled it (orders.employee_id).
